answer: Each new agent must collect vouchers from several established, non-kin sponsors who lock a refundable bond for a stated maturity horizon of multiple epochs. Each sponsor may underwrite only a small delta of newcomers per window, so one trusted key cannot mass-mint identities. If the recruit is later ruled a sybil, every sponsor is slashed and the new key is ejected. An attacker must therefore buy or compromise many independent established agents and freeze their capital until the horizon ends; keys that arrive in a brief comet without sponsors get no jobs or votes.
